# Snapshot ALTER behavior and error messages observed on BigQuery.
# SET OPTIONS and ADD/DROP COLUMN are covered in table_snapshots.txt.

# Renaming a snapshot is allowed and preserves its type.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_rename;
DROP SNAPSHOT TABLE IF EXISTS scalars_snapshot_rename.renamed;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_rename.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_rename.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_rename.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_rename.snap RENAME TO renamed;
SELECT table_type FROM scalars_snapshot_rename.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = 'renamed'
=> "SNAPSHOT"

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_column_options;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_column_options.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_column_options.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_column_options.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_column_options.snap ALTER COLUMN id SET OPTIONS (description = 'changed')
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE ALTER COLUMN only supports modifying columns for tables, while snap is a(n) snapshot

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_set_default;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_set_default.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_set_default.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_set_default.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_set_default.snap ALTER COLUMN id SET DEFAULT 1
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE ALTER COLUMN only supports modifying columns for tables, while snap is a(n) snapshot

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_default;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_default.base (id INT64 DEFAULT 1);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_default.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_drop_default.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_default.snap ALTER COLUMN id DROP DEFAULT
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE ALTER COLUMN only supports modifying columns for tables, while snap is a(n) snapshot

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_add_primary_key;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_add_primary_key.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_add_primary_key.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_add_primary_key.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_add_primary_key.snap ADD PRIMARY KEY (id) NOT ENFORCED
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE only supports altering constraints for tables while snap is a SNAPSHOT

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_primary_key;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_primary_key.base (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_primary_key.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_drop_primary_key.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_primary_key.snap DROP PRIMARY KEY
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE only supports altering constraints for tables while snap is a SNAPSHOT

# SET DEFAULT COLLATE has a different error from SET OPTIONS.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_default_collate;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_default_collate.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_default_collate.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_default_collate.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_default_collate.snap SET DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci'
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE only supports altering default collation for tables while snap is a SNAPSHOT
